__meta.updated_by: AI drafting in plain spoken register

state.as_expected: {{land}} is growing as it should for this stage.
state.slower: {{land}} is growing a little slower than the fields around it.
state.something_wrong: Something looks off in {{land}}. Worth a walk through the field.
state.unclear: Clouds have hidden {{land}} for a while. We will look again on the next clear day.
state.no_data: The satellite has not had a clear look at {{land}} yet.
state.radar_note: Radar can see through cloud: the crop is still standing.
state.need_sowing: Tell us when you sowed, and we can compare with how the crop should look now.

sky.cloudy: Last clear view was {{days}} days ago

nb.title: Compared to nearby crop
nb.well_behind: Your field is clearly behind the crop around it.
nb.behind: Your field is a little behind the crop around it.
nb.with: Your field is keeping pace with the crop around it.
nb.ahead: Your field is doing better than the crop around it.
nb.unknown: Not enough crop nearby was seen clearly to compare yet.

water.title: Water in the field
water.warn: Soil water is running low and the crop's moisture signal has fallen since the last view. Check for wilting and irrigate if you can.
water.depleted: The soil water balance says the field needs water. The satellite has not seen a change yet.
water.ndmi_drop: The crop's moisture signal fell since the last view. Keep an eye on the field this week.
water.watch: One sign of drying, not confirmed yet. Keep an eye on the field.
water.ok: No sign of water shortage right now.
water.none: Not enough weather and satellite data yet to judge water.

ask.title: What to check
ask.cta: Take a photo of the field
ask.urgent: Please walk the field and send a photo of the weakest-looking spot. That tells us more than the satellite can.
ask.routine: A photo now and then helps the satellite view stay accurate for your field.

season.title: Season so far
season.need_more: Once the satellite has two clear views, your season curve appears here.
season.need_sowing: Add your sowing date to see how the crop should look at each stage.
season.no_band: No expected range is set for this stage yet.
season.figure_note: Illustration from the crop's stage table — not a photo of your field.

map.north_hint: Top of the map is north. Your field is outlined.
